statement: A Wyoming business entity changes to a different registered agent by filing the Secretary of State's Appointment of New Registered Agent and Office form with a $5.00 filing fee, certifying compliance with the Registered Offices and Agents Act (W.S. 17-28-101 through 17-28-111), and the form includes the new agent's signed Consent to Appointment.
caveat: The form is mail-only ('cannot be accepted via email') with processing up to 15 business days; an agent's own address update or resignation uses separate forms, and commercial registered agents file under their own CRA regime. Verify the live forms page before filing. This repo does not file the change.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (state process variants wave 2026-10-22); independent domain expert review pending
